first.rationale: Verify the onboarding result and its complex-workspace churn tradeoff before acting. The current intent is a guarded simplification for self-serve/SMB accounts while preserving the full flow for complex workspaces. Promotional pricing is also worth verifying because it may address competitor pressure, but the inherited retention harm makes it a weaker sustainable-revenue choice.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test for simple self-serve and SMB accounts, where prior evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved activation. Keep the full onboarding flow for complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased their 60-day churn by 9%. Measure activation, completion, qualified revenue, and retention against a control; do not use promotional pricing because its 12% retention decline undermines sustainable long-term revenue.
